hero.title: Find the cause.
hero.lede: Physiotherapy that tests, treats and re-tests, so you can see yourself getting better. Scroll through one knee, from the first assessment to back on the pitch.

stages.c: An hour together: how it happened, how it moves, and what makes it worse. We measure everything.
Irritated patellar tendon from too much running too soon. You leave knowing exactly what it is.
Soft tissue work and joint mobilisation to settle it down, and two exercises to do at home.
Slow, heavy holds that the tendon loves. The bend comes back as the pain goes.
Single-leg strength until both sides match, then hopping and changes of direction.
Full bend, no pain, both legs equal. Back to training, with a plan to stay there.

where.title: Tell us where. We'll tell you what helps.
where.sub: Pick the area that's bothering you to see what we usually find, how many sessions it tends to take, and what to do in the meantime.

areas.line: Usually overload rather than damage: the tendon or the joint saying it was asked for too much, too soon.
areas.flag: It locks, gives way, or swelled up straight after a fall.

areas.line: Very common and rarely serious. Most backs get better faster when you keep gently moving.
areas.flag: Numbness around the groin, or trouble with your bladder or bowels.

areas.line: Often posture and stress as much as injury. We treat it and change what keeps causing it.
areas.flag: Pain after a big impact, or weakness in both arms.

areas.line: A shallow joint that relies on its muscles. Most shoulders improve with the right strength work.
areas.meanwhile: Keep it moving below shoulder height
areas.flag: You can't lift the arm at all after a fall.

areas.line: Hip pain can come from the joint, the tendons on the side, or even the back. We find which.
areas.meanwhile: Avoid sleeping on the sore side
areas.flag: Sudden severe pain with a fever.

areas.line: Sprains heal best with early, guided movement, not weeks of rest.
areas.flag: You can't put any weight on it at all.

treatments.title: Clear prices. No packages to sign up to.
treatments.sub: Pay for each session as you go. Most people need three to six; we'll tell you honestly at the first one.

treats.d: Assessment, first treatment and a written plan
Deep tissue work for training or desk tension
Longer session, whole back or both legs
Alongside physio, for pain that won't settle
Filmed on the treadmill, with a plan to fix it

book.title: Pick a time that works.
book.sub: Choose who you'd like to see and a slot. New patients start with a full assessment; you'll get a text the day before.
book.note: Wear shorts or loose clothes so we can see the area. Cancel free up to 24 hours before.
